subject: MSA / Order Form: pen test clearance, SOC2 timing & evidence oncall rotation
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@medcore.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: MSA / Order Form: pen test clearance, SOC2 timing & evidence oncall rotation

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As discussed, attaching a first-pass redline of the security exhibit for the Order Form to capture the pen-test access, SOC 2 evidence cadence, and a proposed on-call rotation for evidence requests during the validation window. Goals for this thread:

- Confirm a 2-week pen-test window (we'd prefer mid-July but open to your constraints)
- Lock in SOC 2 evidence delivery timing and what we can redact for procurement
- Agree on an evidence on-call rotation (point contacts & escalation ladder) so we don't delay your review cycles

Key asks for MedCore: can you confirm whether the internal security team needs a whitelist IP window (and if so the CIDR range) and whether procurement needs a formal SOC 2 "clean" copy or if the redacted PDF will suffice to move to signature?

Attachments: MedCore_SecurityExhibit_v1_redline.pdf, pen_test_scope_matrix.xlsx, SOC2_report_redacted.pdf

If handy, would you be able to propose 2 candidate pen-test windows the week of Jul 12 and Jul 19 so we can align infra/ops? We can spin up ephemeral staging access for whichever window you pick.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Assurance Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0142

--

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 08:47 AM Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@medcore.com> wrote:
> Hi Stephanie —
> 
> Appreciate the doc and the clarity. A couple quick items from our security and procurement sides: 
> 
> 1) Pen-test window: security@medcore.com prefers a single 5-business-day window, not a multi-week span. Can Redwood confirm tooling/ops cover for ephemeral credentials and a guaranteed rollback snapshot?
> 2) SOC 2: Procurement wants the full report behind NDA but the board wants to see redacted artifacts up front. The redacted PDF you attached works as long as it contains the SOC 2 auditor name and report date.
> 3) Evidence cadence: we have two reviewers (security and compliance); we need a 48-hour SLA on small evidence asks during the validation window — is that feasible for Redwood?
> 
> I'll pull in procurement on the next reply if that helps.
> 
> Cheers,
> Alice

From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@medcore.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medcore.com, procurement@medcore.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form: pen test clearance, SOC2 timing & evidence oncall rotation

Stephanie —

Following up from my quick note. Security is asking for:

- A single 5-business-day pen test window (preferred)
- A pre-auth checklist for testers (IP allow list, VPN jump host, temporary creds TTL, accepted scanning tools)
- Confirmation of rollback snapshots and data-handling restrictions (no exfil without prior approval)

Procurement asked me to confirm that the redacted SOC 2 has the auditor name/date and a note about the scope (in-scope services). If Redwood can produce a short attestation email from your compliance team (1 paragraph) summarizing the scope + auditor, that will speed signature on the Order Form.

Also: does Redwood have an on-call rota for evidence when a customer runs a tight validation window? If yes please share names/roles and escalation points — procurement likes to see this in the exhibit.

Thanks,
Alice
MedCore Security

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form: pen test clearance, SOC2 timing & evidence oncall rotation

Stephanie — quick internal notes to coordinate legal and ops before we reply: 

1) Legal redlines: Laura, please confirm we can accept MedCore's one week (5 business days) pen-test window but push language that requires advance notice (minimum 10 business days) so we have infra time to prepare and a confirmed rollback snapshot. Our standard MSA requires 14 days notice; suggest we compromise to 10 days for enterprise deals.

2) Evidence SLA: we can commit to a 48-hour response for "small evidence asks" (logs, screenshots, config snapshots) when we have a named evidence on-call. Ops will need a guaranteed business-hours window and an after-hours escalation list.

3) SOC 2 attestation: Recommend Stephanie circulate a 1-paragraph compliance attestation signed by our Security Director (I can ask Gregg to sign) that explicitly states auditor name, report date, and scope. That should satisfy procurement without exposing raw artifacts.

4) Attachments: update the pen_test_scope_matrix.xlsx to include test-wallet (allowed tools) and the TTL for creds (default 8 hours) — Connor can take this.

If Laura is OK with the 10-day notice and Gregg signs the attestation, we can reply to MedCore this afternoon with a concrete proposal.

—Ben

--

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 11:55 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben / Stephanie — FYI, legal prefers 14 days notice but accepts 10 days as a negotiated term for strategic accounts provided ops confirms rollback and staging isolation. I'll prepare the Order Form amendment language and circulate.
> 
> Laura Bennett
> Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@medcore.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, procurement@medcore.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form: pen test clearance, SOC2 timing & evidence oncall rotation

Alice —

Thanks for the clear asks. Summary and proposed next steps below (agree / edit as needed):

Summary of decisions: 
- Pen-test window: MedCore prefers a single 5-business-day window. Redwood can accommodate that for the Jul 19 window if MedCore can provide 10 business days' notice by Jul 5. Legal has confirmed 10-day compromise is acceptable for this deal; Laura will add the clause to the Order Form amendment.

- Pre-auth checklist: see pen_test_scope_matrix.xlsx (attached). Connor will update allowed tools and TTL to 8 hours. We will provide an IP allow-list (CIDR 3.110.0.0/16) and ephemeral credentials with automated expiry.

- Evidence SLA: Redwood commits to a 48-hour turnaround for small evidence asks during the validation window. Ops on-call (business hours): Connor Obrien (ops), escalation after-hours: Ben Carter (security lead), Legal triage: Laura Bennett. We'll add these names to the exhibit.

- SOC 2 attestation: We'll attach a 1-paragraph attestation from Gregg Morales (Director, Security) that states auditor name (Brightline Auditors LLC), report date (2027-02-14), and scoped services (Redwood inference public API + hosting control plane). The redacted PDF you requested is attached.

Next steps (action owners & timeline):
1) MedCore to confirm which of Jul 12 or Jul 19 you prefer for the 5-day window (Alice) — due by EOD Fri, Jun 18.
2) Redwood to send Order Form amendment with 10-day notice clause and evidence on-call list (Laura) — target Wed, Jun 16.
3) Connor to update pen_test_scope_matrix.xlsx with allowed tools and TTL and circulate (Connor) — target Tue, Jun 16 EOB.
4) Stephanie to email Gregg's attestation and the final redacted SOC 2 (Stephanie) — target Wed, Jun 16.

Attachments: MedCore_SecurityExhibit_v1_redline.pdf, pen_test_scope_matrix.xlsx, SOC2_report_redacted.pdf

If that all looks right I'll mark this as the binding plan and route the Order Form amendment for signature once MedCore confirms the window.

Appreciate the partnership —
Stephanie
